```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`dsem_compute()` detects available CPU allocations through `parallelly`,
respecting containers, CRAN check core limits, and HPC schedulers (Slurm,
PBS/TORQUE, SGE, and LSF). Independent MCMC chains and Monte Carlo replications
execute across isolated PSOCK worker processes while Rust kernels operate
purely on copied numeric buffers without calling the R API from worker threads.

```{r}
library(DSEMr)
dsem_compute()
```

To dispatch four chains across four worker processes on a workstation or Slurm
allocation:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
compute <- dsem_compute(workers = 4, backend = "psock", threads = 1)
fit <- dsem(model, data, chains = 4, compute = compute, seed = 4815)
```

Because chain seeds are derived solely from `(master_seed, model_hash, chain_id)`,
changing `workers` does not alter posterior draws.
